tier_descriptions.SIMPLE: Claude Haiku 5.5, medium effort. Candidate for explicit, local edits, straightforward extraction, shell lookups and routine transformations with clear steps. Escalate when the task requires investigating ambiguous failures or coordinating changes across components.
tier_descriptions.MEDIUM: Claude Sonnet 5.5, high effort. Candidate for ordinary implementation, debugging with multiple steps, tests and integration of familiar components. Escalate when correctness depends on subtle interactions or extensive architectural reasoning.
tier_descriptions.COMPLEX: Claude Opus 5.5, medium effort. Candidate for difficult cross-component debugging, unfamiliar repositories, complex implementations and tasks requiring substantial planning and verification.
tier_descriptions.REASONING: Claude Opus 5.5, high effort. Candidate for difficult reasoning, intricate correctness arguments, subtle concurrency issues and high-complexity planning where additional reasoning effort is expected to improve success.
